dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[FL-20250918-PAK-00](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_fl_events/items?eventid=FL-20250918-PAK-00) A flood occurred on Sep 18 2025 in Pakistan. It affected an estimated 16793460 people and 2637108 ha of cropland. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
